description: This C# source file defines a data set class for unit testing, specifically for grains with Cyrillic IDs and names in an Orleans-based project. It provides test data generation methods and enumerators for test cases.

classes.name: StorageDataSet2CyrillicIdsAndGrainNames
classes.description: A data set class for generating test data with Cyrillic IDs and grain names for Orleans grains, supporting enumeration over test cases.

methods.name: GetTestData
methods.description: Returns a tuple containing a grain type string, a random grain ID, and a grain state object for a given test case number.

methods.name: GetEnumerator
methods.description: Provides an enumerator over the range of test case indices.
